searchText: hi <@364458974906548225> , https://4bytes.directory/ has been down for a few days. could you look into it please? 🙂 should be back up, looks like my certbot automation didn't actually run correctly.... I'm strongly considering taking that service down at some point soon. I'm not sure what the best way to do that would be but I'm no longer interested in maintaining it and while it takes minimal mainenance, it is non-zero.... curious if anyone has any thoughts on how best to proceed given that I believe there's a number of things that use/depend on it. It is possible you could find someone to take over maintenance of it. Ideally someone who runs other services already and adding another wouldn't be too difficult. Can you share stats on its traffic volume (connections and bandwidth) so a hypothetical successor has an idea of what they are getting into? Also on-disk size, though I suspect that part is inconsequential. It all runs on a single box. 6 cores. 16GB ram, 400GB of disk, currently only uses about 60GB of that disk. CPU cores are running at about 40% load. Bandwidth averages 1.8 Mb/s outbound, 800Kb/s inbound (250GB/587GB in/out for March)
